text:
:= by
  rw [StrictMono]
  constructor
  · intros h s a ha
    have := h (s ∪ {a}) (insert_mem _ _)
    rw [Finset.union_insert, Finset.insert_union]
    exact this
  · intros h s t hs ht
    cases le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (h s t hs ht) with hst
    · exact hst
    · rw [Finset.eq_iff_subset_both]
      rw [Finset.subset_def] at hst
      exact hst.1
      exact hst.2
